source: python ml/flood_inference.py domain-check (Sen1Floods11 India sample chips vs Planetary Computer sentinel-1-rtc)
method: per-band linear map in dB (gain * dB + offset), least squares on matched 1-99th percentiles of S1Hand vs RTC over co-valid pixels (label-free), applied before normalisation
rule: adopted when the RTC IoU drops by more than 0.05 and the leave-one-out calibrated IoU is higher
